prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Listen and Choose Your Companion", "Select a pet to hear their unique sounds and personality style.", "Preview Sound", "Select Pet"]
1: ["Unbox Your Companion's First Toy!", "Your companion brought a desk toy to play with when resting.", "Open Gift Box", "Unwrap Toy", "Welcome to Your New Desktop Partner"]
2: ["Secure Your Pet Data & Cloud Save", "Signing in anchors your pet to your cloud account so progress is never lost across reinstalls.", "Automatic Cloud Restore Enabled"]
3: ["Crafting Your Companion's Desktop Assets", "Rigging Animations", "Rendering Sprites & Sound Effects"]
4: ["Which Desktop Companion Fits Your Workflow?", "Focus Companion vs Playful Desktop Buddy"]
5: ["Upload Photo for Custom Pet Creation", "Ensure your face/pet photo is well-lit inside the central ring for crisp 2D sprite rendering."]
6: ["Configure Your Desktop Companion Habits", "Set active hours, quiet study mode, and quick desktop hide hotkeys.", "Active Work Hours & Auto-Hide Rules"]
7: ["Choose Express Account Protection", "Sign in in 1 click using device credentials to lock in your pet's memory.", "Continue with Passkey", "Continue with Email"]
8: ["A gentle chime will play when your pet is ready to land on your desktop taskbar.", "Estimated Completion"]
9: ["Welcome to the World of Desktop Pets", "Little digital creatures that live right on your desktop, helping you work and keep you company.", "Begin Companion Journey"]
